jobs.name: torihiki-bench-iteration
jobs.prompt: Torihiki benchmark cycle. Follow your Torihiki bounded builder role from SOUL.md. Run `clojure -M:test` and optionally `clojure -M:bench` in the assigned Torihiki worktree; record exact revision, host load, failures, assertions, and throughput under evidence/. Host load > 20 means not-run evidence only. Scheduled cycle is measurement-only; no code changes. If dispatched a bounded implementation task, follow its acceptance condition in that task's isolated worktree and request torihiki-falsify review. Final report at most 200 words; do not paste full test output.
